sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report involves customer C13487 and card C13487-K1 associated with billing region 191. Between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-26, three unauthorized card-not-present transactions totaling $439.61 were initiated using card C13487-K1. Specifically, online transaction 3460634 occurred on 2016-11-15 20:30:00 for $112.37, followed by transaction 3478561 on 2016-11-22 16:11:00 for $74.96, and transaction 3489320 on 2016-11-26 17:39:00 for $252.28. All three transactions were conducted online through device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080. Identity records show this device profile was entirely new to cardholder C13487 and operated through an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS). Graph analytics identified that this identical device profile was shared across 24 other cards between 2016-11-14 and 2016-11-29, including connected cards C01289-K1, C01996-K2, and C02910-K1. Furthermore, historical case analysis linked this device profile to four prior confirmed fraud cases: CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035. The coordinated unauthorized use of compromised card details across multiple accounts from a single anonymous proxy device indicates organized payment card fraud. The bank has blocked card C13487-K1, placed connected cards under monitoring, and filed this report.
